user_saw: After pressing Ctrl-C or sending SIGTERM to `openclaw skills list/info/check`, the command kept waiting for the Gateway read and then printed timeout diagnostics or the full report anyway.
summary: Forwards the command's async-work abort signal into the skills.status Gateway read, stops offline fallback after abort, and suppresses late output and the missing-skill exit when interrupted.
reasoning: loadSkillsStatusReport never passed an abort signal; the call shape predates the 2026-09-03 graft (3949fc0850e5 and 08f4a198a310 only refactored and moved it), and skills-cli.ts first used getAsyncWorkSignal on the same day as this fix (#198163 for skills update). The cooperative signal-exit machinery (src/cli/signal-exit-barrier.ts, async-work-scope.ts) is also older than the graft, so I could not tell whether these reads were written without cancellation from the start (never-worked) or were exposed when SIGINT handling became cooperative (latent), and I could not identify either commit.
